## lib-config (N8N-2.6 seed, data only)
**Trigger:** called through Execute Workflow by sched-alert-queue (which passes the result on to lib-alert-queue-drain and the playbook), recv-thehive-event, recv-n8n-start, chk-wazuh-response, and recv-wazuh-alert (only when the alert queue is unavailable).
**Inputs:** none (input items are ignored).
**Actions taken:** none: returns the SOAR's mappings as one item (severity, TLP/PAP, sources, the routing table and playbook IDs (N8N-1.3; how to add a row: README "Routing"), observable types and the decoders whose user fields need care (`observable_user_fields`), the `data.url` split into `url` / `uri_path` and its cap (`observable_url`, `observable_caps`), the FIM tags, deleted-hash note and title cap (`fim`, `title_caps`; X-44), intake exclusions, writeback marker, whether TheHive is deployed here from `THEHIVE_ENABLED`, TheHive and Cortex call timeouts and retries (`thehive_http`, `cortex_http`), the enrichment policy (`enrichment`: analyzers, skip rules, the absolute-URL rule, VirusTotal's severe path (D-N7), the per-alert budget (D-N8), limits, verdict mapping; README "Enrichment policy", N8N-2.4), the SSH correlation settings (`ssh_correlation`: window, escalation severity, tags, comment marker; N8N-4.2), the malware hash settings (`malware`: verdicts that tag and escalate, escalation severity, same-hash window, limits; N8N-4.3), the response actions (`response`: kill switch, dry_run / live from `ASOX_RESPONSE_MODE` (fail closed: anything else is dry_run), the firewall-drop catalog, agent group, routes, approval tag and window, protected addresses (loopback plus `ASOX_RESPONSE_PROTECTED_CIDRS`), rate cap; `wazuh_http`: Wazuh API timeouts and retries; C9 v0), and the C11 metrics settings (`metrics`: template fields and types, first-time fields, skipped sources, indexer timeout and retries, attack-start lookup; N8N-2.9)).
**Systems changed:** none.
**Approval:** not needed: no system changes.
**Owner:** n8n.
Temporary entries name the ticket they wait on. Successful executions are not saved (called for every alert).
